q: What is the building footprint if the owner used the minimum required setbacks, but increased one side setback to 6m in order to accommodate the carport?
n: R-1 setbacks (Table VIII.2): front 4.50 m, side 2.00 m, rear 2.00 m. A through lot has a "front" on both streets, so 4.50 m is applied at both ends. Depth = 1,000 / 24 = 41.667 m. Source: 2004 Revised IRR of PD 1096 (NBCP), Rule VIII, Table VIII.2.
